notes: One row per place a person or a machine can get Replay from. This file is data, not prose: replay.doctor generates its install page from it (scripts/gen-install.mjs), a weekly job checks every row marked live still serves the latest release (scripts/check-channels.mjs), and the tests refuse a row marked live that has no verify step.

status: live = a clean machine installs from it today; building = code exists, not yet published; planned = nothing yet; blocked = a gate we cannot pass; skipped = ruled out on purpose (the reason is in gate).

automation: goreleaser = emitted by .goreleaser.yaml on tag; workflow = a GitHub Actions job on release; index = the site indexes us automatically once an artefact exists; pr = a one-time pull request to someone else's repository; form = a one-time submission form; manual = a human does it each time and it should be rare.
gate OSI means the channel requires an OSI-approved licence; BSL 1.1 is not one until 2029-09-06. 1.0 changes nothing about that; only a licence change does.
Windows is not supported. Rows that need it are skipped, never fudged.
check: how the weekly job reads the live version. github-latest is the reference every other row is compared against.
